method: Author assessment against frozen executed evidence. Adequate does not imply protocol-perfect, exhaustiveness or executed method behavior. Failed/partial requests, inferred meanings and off-profile reads are explicit.

package-hal.reading: One full command-local HAL, then cached jq selection; no narrower refetch. Retrieved fewer bytes than baseline, but rendered more through multiple local views.

package-data.qualification: Same package/direct declaration/group/bound with no indirect or exhaustive claim. Reads transitive constraints, then executes exact direct depends=Polly.
package-data.reading: Query help then one direct depends-transitive facet closure; no repeated structured request. One fewer request than baseline but guide-inclusive retrieval/rendering both larger.

api-hal.qualification: Actual HttpClient/HttpContent receivers, declaring types/library and JsonTypeInfo representative signatures for GetFromJsonAsync, PostAsJsonAsync and ReadFromJsonAsync; installed runtime and inferred, unexecuted workflow semantics explicit.

api-data.qualification: Actual HttpClient/HttpContent/ASP.NET HttpResponse receivers, declaring types/library, signatures and documented GetFromJsonAsync/ReadFromJsonAsync/WriteAsJsonAsync utility. Third member request exits 1 with two rejected metadata rows. Selected overload is present and independently reported by successful extension inspection; partial warning and scope are disclosed.
api-data.reading: Help, three extension inspections, member help and three member documentation inspections. Documentation adds behavior details absent from extension signatures; do not classify all these as verification-only. No explanation/assigned reading format used. One jq error on null signatures retained. Substantially greater retrieval than baseline reflects different methods and documentation depth, not direct JSON cost.

vocabulary-hal.qualification: 72 catalog values, native IDs, Break display name and selected-scope omission. Prose value meanings are qualified ordinary interpretations, not asserted catalog definitions.
vocabulary-hal.reading: Immediate collection bootstrap, full vocabulary then redundant selected copy. Full response already contains count, summary and both value records; selected copy adds selection scope but no new requested domain facts. It could have narrowed on the first reading because task IDs were supplied.

vocabulary-data.reading: Immediate collection bootstrap, one failed short-name request, full direct vocabulary, then ordinary vocabulary resource and two value details seeking identity/description data. Correct direct reading already supplied native keys, vocabulary summary, Break name and count. Extra records add encoded explanation identity but no missing requested domain meaning. No -Q use. Three successful reads leave the assigned reading profile; this is retained separately from the zero cross-direct/HAL profile mismatch count.
